name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately.
htmlExample:
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-switch default-checked></bef-switch> Notifications</label>
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-switch></bef-switch> Dark mode</label>
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-switch disabled></bef-switch> Disabled</label>
